sn7.21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena saṅgāravo nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati. udakasuddhiko udakena parisuddhiṃ pacceti. sāyapātaṃ udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
sn7.21:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
sn7.21:1.4: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.21:1.5: idha bhante saṅgāravo nāma brāhmaṇo sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati, udakasuddhiko udakena parisuddhiṃ pacceti sāyapātaṃ udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharati.
sn7.21:1.6: sādhu bhante bhagavā yena saṅgāravassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn7.21:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena saṅgāravassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn7.21:2.2: atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn7.21:2.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn7.21:2.4: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ brāhmaṇa udakasuddhiko udakena parisuddhiṃ paccesi. sāyapātaṃ udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharasīti.
sn7.21:2.6: kimpana tvaṃ brāhmaṇa atthavasaṃ sampassamāno udakasuddhiko udakena parisuddhiṃ paccesi. sāyapātaṃ udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharasīti?
sn7.21:2.7: idha me bho gotama yaṃ divā pāpakammaṃ kataṃ hoti, taṃ sāya nahānena pavāhemi. yaṃ rattiṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ hoti, taṃ pāta nahānena pavāhemi.
sn7.21:2.8: imaṃ khvāhaṃ bho gotama atthavasaṃ sampassamāno udakasuddhiko udakena parisuddhiṃ paccemi. sāyapātaṃ udakorohanānuyogamanuyutto viharāmīti.
sn7.21:4.1: evaṃ vutte saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.21:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
